---
title: "Billboard Hot 100"
format: html
---
execute:
  echo: false

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
billboard <- read_csv("data/billboard.csv")
```

```{r}
billboard_long <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank"
  ) |>
  mutate(week = readr::parse_number(week))

song_summary <- billboard_long |>
  filter(!is.na(rank)) |>
  group_by(artist, track) |>
  summarize(
    first_rank = first(rank),
    best_rank = min(rank),
    first_week_at_best = min(week[rank == min(rank)]),
    weeks_on_chart = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
top10_songs <- song_summary |>
  filter(best_rank <= 10)

fastest_to_number_one <- top10_songs |>
  filter(best_rank == 1) |>
  slice_min(first_week_at_best, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

slowest_to_number_one <- top10_songs |>
  filter(best_rank == 1) |>
  slice_max(first_week_at_best, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

longest_chart_run <- top10_songs |>
  slice_max(weeks_on_chart, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
```

```{r}
notable_songs <- bind_rows(
  fastest_to_number_one |> mutate(category = "Fastest to #1"),
  slowest_to_number_one |> mutate(category = "Slowest to #1"),
  longest_chart_run |> mutate(category = "Longest chart run")
) |>
  distinct(artist, track, .keep_all = TRUE)

top10_trajectories <- billboard_long |>
  semi_join(top10_songs, by = c("artist", "track")) |>
  left_join(
    notable_songs |> select(artist, track, category),
    by = c("artist", "track")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    highlight = if_else(is.na(category), "Other top-10 songs", category)
  )

ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = filter(top10_trajectories, highlight == "Other top-10 songs"),
    aes(x = week, y = rank, group = interaction(artist, track)),
    color = "gray70",
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = filter(top10_trajectories, highlight != "Other top-10 songs"),
    aes(
      x = week,
      y = rank,
      group = interaction(artist, track),
      color = highlight
    ),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Notable songs",
    values = c(
      "Fastest to #1" = "blue",
      "Slowest to #1" = "red",
      "Longest chart run" = "darkgreen"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Week",
    y = "Billboard ranking",
    title = "Chart Trajectories of Top-10 Songs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
